english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications
statement_en: For a given irrational number $\alpha$, for every $\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$, there exist a positive integer $q$ and an integer $p$ such that $$|q\alpha-\beta-p|<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 对于给定的无理数$\alpha$，以及$\forall \beta\in\mathbb{R}$，$\forall \varepsilon > 0$都存在正整数$q$以及整数$p$使得$$|q\alpha-\beta-p|<\varepsilon$$
